EN.All the Sauces R1 ist eine moderne Hybri:
All the Sauces R1 is a modern hybrid strain from ETHOS Genetics, created by crossing Original Zkittlez and Wrank. This strain combines the intense fruity and candy-like aromas of the Original Z line with the robust structure, vitality, and gassy depth of Wrank.

In our selection, All the Sauces is used exclusively for the production of rosin. This is due to its pronounced resin production, large trichome heads, and complex terpene profile, which comes through particularly intensely and with great depth in the concentrate.

As rosin, the strain develops a highly concentrated aroma of sweet Z terpenes, fresh citrus, floral and earthy nuances, as well as a distinctive gas and gasoline component. It is precisely this combination that makes All the Sauces a particularly interesting extraction cultivar for us.

All the Sauces produces a powerful and balanced hybrid effect. Initially, euphoria, a positive mood, and a distinctly noticeable mental clarity often take center stage.

As the experience progresses, a pleasant physical relaxation sets in without completely overshadowing the mental effects. In concentrated rosin, the effects can be correspondingly intense and should not be underestimated when it comes to dosing.

EN.Lemon Game ist eine extrem seltene Hybri:

EN.LH2P, ausgeschrieben Liquid Hydrogen Pea:
LH2P, which stands for Liquid Hydrogen Peach, is a modern hybrid strain from Perfect Tree, created by crossing their award-winning Jet A-Cut with Peach Ozz. This strain combines the massive resin production, potency, and robust fuel-like aroma of Jet A with the sweet, fruity Z-terpenes of the Peach Ozz line.

LH2P produces medium-sized, easy-to-grow plants with excellent resin production and attractive, heavily frosted buds. Particularly exciting is the distinct phenotypic range: Some plants lean heavily toward the Jet A side and develop a distinctly gassy, fuel-like profile, while others exhibit more candy and fruit notes. Peach Ozz-dominant specimens can be especially sweet, tropical, and fruit-forward.

LH2P produces a powerful, predominantly relaxing hybrid high. The effect may initially start out euphoric and pleasantly mentally engaging before the physical component increasingly takes center stage.

Jet-A-dominant phenotypes, in particular, can be extremely potent and heavy. Fruiter Peach-Ozz phenotypes, on the other hand, are often perceived as somewhat more balanced. Overall, the effect is relaxing, long-lasting, and physically noticeable, without necessarily becoming strongly sedating right away.
EN.London Lobster ist eine außergewöhnliche:

As the experience progresses, a pleasant physical relaxation sets in, which has a calming effect without immediately leading to strong drowsiness. As a result, London Lobster combines the energizing qualities of classic Cheese genetics with the comfortable serenity of modern Indicas.

EN.Romscotti ist eine exklusive Black Label:

EN.Romulan ist eine legendäre kanadische Ku:
Romulan is a legendary Canadian cult strain whose origins date back to the 1960s. It became famous for its extraordinary potency, robust nature, and distinctive aroma. Today’s version from Romulan Genetics is based on the preservation and further development of these historic genetics by Romulan Jake. Despite its long history, Romulan has maintained its reputation as one of North America’s most distinctive and reliable strains.

Romulan is famous for its intense yet clear high. The effects are described as powerful, long-lasting, and, at the same time, surprisingly anxiety-free. The strain often produces a happy, contented cerebral high, accompanied by deep physical relaxation. Many users report a “ceiling-less high”—an effect that, while very potent, does not abruptly turn into overwhelming anxiety or paranoia.

The combination of mental clarity and physical calm makes Romulan one of the few classic strains that is perceived as both relaxing and functional.

EN.Unser selektierter Falcon Heavy-Phänotyp:
Our select Falcon Heavy phenotype can be described in two words: Full Gas.

If there were a fuel capable of catapulting a Falcon weighing several metric tons into the air, this is exactly what it would smell like. From the very first whiff, an uncompromising fuel profile unfolds, featuring sharp kerosene, sweet gasoline, and rich diesel. The aroma is bold, aggressive, and exceptionally intense—exactly what enthusiasts of classic fuel terpenes are looking for.

In the background, subtle creamy and earthy nuances add depth without overshadowing the dominant fuel character. The result is an unmistakable terpene profile reminiscent of a mix of an airfield, a gas station, and the racetrack—one that impresses even seasoned cannabis connoisseurs.

For fans of uncompromising “gas” genetics, this phenotype is an absolute highlight—“Full Gas” is no exaggeration here, but rather the name of the game.

Falcon Heavy produces an exceptionally intense and long-lasting high. The effects begin with a pleasant euphoria and mental clarity before a deep physical relaxation quickly sets in. Due to its high THC content and immense potency, this strain is primarily intended for experienced users. At higher doses, it can have a distinctly sedative effect and is particularly well-suited for the evening or quiet moments.
EN.Unser selektierter Fat Catz-Phänotyp wir:

Particularly characteristic is the exceptionally dense and heavy smoke. It feels full-bodied and creamy, lingering on the palate for a long time. The combination of dark Kush, floral soapy notes, and creamy depth gives our Fat Catz a high level of distinctiveness and clearly sets it apart from fruitier or candy-forward phenotypes of this strain.

Our Fat Catz has a surprisingly intense and potent effect. The high kicks in strongly and quickly transitions into a deep physical relaxation. Even experienced users may be surprised by the pronounced intensity and depth of the effect.

The strain has a calming, body-focused effect that becomes increasingly heavy. At higher doses, it can become distinctly sedating and literally knock even seasoned users off their feet.
